phrases.english: I want to learn Arabic very much.
phrases.arabic: أريد أن أتعلم اللغة العربية كثيرًا.
phrases.pronunciation: Ureed an ata'allam al-lughah al-'arabiyyah katheeran.
phrases.context: Use this to express your strong desire to study the Arabic language.

phrases.english: This Arabic word is difficult for me.
phrases.arabic: هذه الكلمة العربية صعبة بالنسبة لي.
phrases.pronunciation: Hadhihi al-kalimah al-'arabiyyah sa'bah bil-nisbah li.
phrases.context: Use this when you find a specific Arabic word challenging to understand or pronounce.

phrases.english: I practice speaking Arabic every day.
phrases.arabic: أمارس التحدث باللغة العربية كل يوم.
phrases.pronunciation: Umaarisu al-tahadduth bil-lughah al-'arabiyyah kull yawm.
phrases.context: Use this to communicate your dedication to practicing Arabic conversation regularly.

phrases.english: Learning Arabic opens many doors for me.
phrases.arabic: تعلم اللغة العربية يفتح لي أبوابًا كثيرة.
phrases.pronunciation: Ta'allum al-lughah al-'arabiyyah yaftahu li abwaaban katheerah.
phrases.context: Use this to describe the opportunities that learning Arabic provides.

phrases.english: I am motivated by the rich culture of Arabic-speaking countries.
phrases.arabic: أنا متحمس للثقافة الغنية للدول العربية.
phrases.pronunciation: Ana mutahammis lil-thaqafah al-ghaniyyah lil-duwal al-'arabiyyah.
phrases.context: Use this to explain what drives your motivation to learn Arabic.
